text:
alex_k: Quick readout from today's vendor roadmap sync — overall positive but we need a tight embargo handshake across HW, marketplace, and SI comms :handshake:
mia_l: Good to hear. Can you summarize the blockers? Especially anything that would delay Marketplace listing windows.
alex_k: Blockers: 1) Gaudi region rollouts not fully confirmed (APAC availability TBD), 2) SI partner needs finalized cert image (they asked for a 48h lead on golden image), 3) press embargo windows overlap across vendors so legal wants a single source of truth.
raj_p: For SI integrations — we should publish a minimal "onramp checklist" they can consume. Items: golden image tag, sample inference config, load profile, and a contact for rollback. If SI has 48h lead time, we need to move our internal cutover earlier.
sophie_t: From Press Ops: we need exact embargo start/end times in UTC, a short embargo-safe summary, and a single contacts file (vendor PR + our comms). Also ask vendors for a strict DO NOT SHARE list for embargo period. :mega:
alex_k: Draft embargo windows (proposal):
```
- H100/H200/B200: 2026-05-12 08:00 UTC -> 2026-05-12 14:00 UTC
- MI300: 2026-05-19 09:00 UTC -> 2026-05-19 15:00 UTC
- Gaudi: rolling region release 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-07 (APAC gating)
```
mia_l: Those look tight. Marketplace needs 72h to stage assets and validate billing SKU mappings. Can we get signed assets by 2026-05-09 for the first wave?
alex_k: We asked vendors for golden images by 2026-05-07. If SI still needs 48h, that should work for H100 wave but not Gaudi rolling.
raj_p: I'll draft the SI checklist today. Proposed items to include:
- image: tag & sha256
- inference config: batch_size, seq_len sample
- perf baseline: p95 latency at target qps
- ORT/driver version matrix
- rollback playbook + contact
sophie_t: Also add a short line for "marketing-safe" language we can put in feeds if embargo leaks. Example: "We are excited to expand our hardware options with leading partners; full details to follow post-announcement."
alex_k: Good. Also vendor asks: (1) embargo exceptions for partner demos? They want a 1-on-1 demo carveout with signed NDA — we should decide on policy. (2) A shared calendar invite with all vendor and SI leads.
mia_l: Demo carveouts are fine if legal signs NDA and listing is still embargoed. Ops: any automation to track NDAs?
ops_bot: Calendar created: "Vendor Roadmap Announcement - Embargo Coordination" invite sent to stakeholder list. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/2141592653. NDA tracker: https://notion.example.com/nda-tracker (restricted).
raj_p: I'll add a CI job to validate golden image SHA on merge — small script we can share with SI: 
```bash
sha256sum golden-image.tar.gz | grep -i <expected-sha>
```
alex_k: Next steps:
- raj_p to post SI checklist by EOD 2141592899 UTC
- mia_l to confirm marketplace staging window (ok if 72h)
- sophie_t to draft embargo-safe copy and comms contact list
- alex_k to consolidate vendor confirmations and publish final embargo times

mia_l: If anyone needs to push dates, flag now — downstream teams depend on the final times.
sophie_t: I'll start templates for the press release snippets and embargo instructions. Will ping legal for NDA template.
alex_k: Thanks all :thumbsup: — we'll reconvene after checklist + vendor confirmations. If any vendor asks to move into the Gaudi rolling window, call it out in this thread.
ops_bot: Reminder: please upload final golden image artifacts to /partners/golden-images by 2026-05-07 to avoid staging delays.
